name: Punishment Scaling
description: Default scaling (Live [non-indev]): Verbal/1 Minute Ban (warns don’t save) -> 30 Minute Ban -> 1 Hour Ban (60 Minutes) -> 6 Hour Ban (360 Minutes) -> 1 Day Ban (1440 Minutes) -> 1 Week Ban (10080 Minutes) -> 1 Month Ban (40320 Minutes) - Warn that next is permanent -> Permanent Ban [Head Staff needed] -> U. Permanent Ban [Head Staff needed] Default scaling (Indev - Lower tolerance - All unappealable unless false): Verbal/1 Minute Ban (warns don’t save) -> 1 Day Ban (1440 Minutes) -> 1 Week Ban (10080 Minutes) - Warn that next is permanent -> Permanent Ban [Head Staff needed]

name: Cheating
description: Cheating is of course not allowed as it is not allowed by the Roblox TOS, it’s an instant unappealable ban.

fields.text: Proof is essential for this type of ban. Proof must be at least a 20 second video showing what kind of unfair advantage is being given to the users.
All bans related to cheating are unappealable regardless of the severity.

name: Raiding
description: Multiple users (be it a friend group or an intentional disruption group) breaking either the same rule or multiple rules at the same time is a Severity+1 on the highest rule broken.

fields.text: Raiding doesn’t necessarily mean a group; Breaking multiple rules at once in order to cause disruption, even if alone, is counted as raiding.
In such a case where a solo user is raiding, a permanent ban is applicable.

name: Suggestive Avatars
description: We have a very low tolerance for what counts as ‘suggestive’. Please follow the INDEV SCALING in the main game, and UNAPPEALABLE REMOVAL in the indev version.

name: Ban Evasion
description: Evading bans using alts is not tolerated and will result in your ban becoming unappealable and a + 1 scaling for each iteration of this happening. (The alt receiving a permanent ban) <font color="#92ACD8">[All public bans should be considered as ‘evasion’ from Indev, if caught.]</font>

name: Staff Annoyance (& Stalking)
description: Consistently following staff members into servers they are located in would result in a ban following the default LIVE (regardless of Indev / not) scaling.

fields.text: Breaking additional rules will be considered raiding as well.

name: Staff Harassment
description: Same as Staff Annoyance, but using alts to avoid bans related to stalking / annoyance.

fields.text: Staff Impersonation falls under this category.

name: Same Offense
description: If a player keeps doing the same offense over and over, you may skip a scaling level.

name: Excessive Toxicity
description: This is Roblox we are talking about, so there is bound to be toxic players; That said, if a player gets excessively toxic (as in verbal abuse, NOT spamming ‘ez’), staff members should intervene. The punishment is relative to the severity, but otherwise the scaling is default.

name: Recording without permssion
description: [PUBLIC SPECIFIC] If a player has recorded gameplay of a song from the Public branch of the game (after playing against a contributor, for example), please talk with the contributor first before taking action on the player who recorded the songs. The player should not be banned permanently for uploading these songs. [INDEV SPECIFIC] If a player has recorded something without permission from the Indev branch of the game, it should result in a permanent removal from Indev. No exceptions apart from those given permission specifically by the lead developers
